bestBets.overview: On pace runners 3,4,5,8,9 and 11. BESSIE LA BELLE was freshened up and then battled on well in a stronger race at Wagga last start. She has a very good record on the heavy tracks so with McDougall to ride from barrier 2 she looks hardest to beat in this class. The ex Victorian MAGNARDO has an excellent record down there in weaker grade and she does enjoy the wet tracks. SPIRITS BURN DEEP is another who loves these conditions but she hasn't won for a long time. JUSTBETRYIN' who has good pace has a place chance.

raceTips.comment: Spirits Burn Deep brings a solid form profile into this contest and looks suited by the opportunity to settle handy. He has enough pace to avoid getting too far back and should be strong when the pressure builds late. Brutal Eyes has the ability to make his own luck and should be kept in the calculations. He can roll forward and put himself into the race early.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 4 and 12. The lightly raced IKON PARK was strong winning at Albury last start on the heavy ground. He looks even better suited getting to the 1400 metres and in not an overly strong race he will be hard to beat. TOMMY FLYER pulled up with issues last start when well fancied. His previous form was good enough. XERXES draws badly but he still looks to get an easy lead. He is a winner over 1600 metres so is sure to give a sight. DEEKAYGEEBEE was strong winning last start in weaker grade.

raceTips.comment: Sundrop has the profile of a horse capable of making his presence felt and should get every opportunity to settle in a favourable position. He has enough speed to hold a handy spot and can be effective when produced at the right time. Brass Monkeys has been holding his form well and looks suited by a race where he can settle close to the action. He should give a strong kick when asked for an effort. Special Prophet has enough ability to threaten late and should not be overlooked. He can settle midfield and finish off solidly when the gaps appear.
